name: ColorCodex Color Lookup Agent
description: A read-only agent that retrieves HTML/CSS named color codes (hex, RGB, HSL) and performs hex-to-rgb/hsl conversion via the Model Context Protocol at /mcp.

skills.name: Lookup Color
skills.description: Retrieve HTML/CSS named color by name. Returns hex, RGB, HSL codes.

skills.name: Convert Color
skills.description: Convert hex color string to RGB and HSL representations.
